typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

file.description:
The {@link File} object which contains the python class implementation of the
algorithm.

className.description:
The {@link file} may contain many classes as part of its internal implementation detail.
However, there still is a single class which contains the overall logic of the algorithm.
This field defines the name of that python class.

classKwargs.description:
Defines all the named arguments to the `__init__` function of the python class defined
by {@link className}.

actionRequirement.description:
The contents of the {@link file} must be run in a runtime / conda environment appropriate to
the execution requirements of the algorithm. Define the {@link Action.Requirement} in this field.

convertSpec.description: Defines additional metadata for the instantiation of the {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe}.

inheritsFrom.description:
If the class(es) in the python {@link file} either inherit from or employ the use of other
factory implementations, define those dependencies in this field. All the python class names
defined here MUST be instances of {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeFactory}.

childFactory.description:
The `childFactory` refers to a specific instance of {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeFactory} that is used to create
individual custom pipes for the assets in the population.

title:
{@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPopulationPipeFactory} is an extension of the {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeFactory}
that is designed to handle the creation and management of custom pipelines for a population of {@link ReliabilityAsset}s.
This factory is responsible for generating pipelines that operate on data from multiple assets, combining them to create
a unified dataset for training, inference, or other purposes.

It can be used in scenarios where the processing logic needs to handle a group of assets.
name: ReliabilityMl.CustomPopulationPipeFactory
